newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: SOCCER-PARAGUAY BEAT VENEZUELA TO CLOSE GAP AT TOP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARAGUAY BEAT VENEZUELA TO CLOSE GAP AT TOP.

text.p: Paraguay closed the gap on Colombia at the top of the South American World Cup qualifying group to three points on Sunday with a 2-0 win over lightweights Venezuela.
The outcome ensured Paraguay would remain second in the group regardless of the results of the three games being played later on Sunday.
Any hopes table-propping Venezuela may have had of an upset disappeared in the fifth minute when Miguel Angel Benitez shot Paraguay ahead.
Paraguay increased their lead through Julio Enciso in the 62nd minute with Venezuela appealing for offside.

Venezuela: 1-Rafael Dudamel, 2-David McIntosh, 3-Jhon Medina, 4-Alexander Echenique, 6-Jose Vallenilla; 5-Luis Ramos, 7-Juan Castellanos (15-Luis Tizamo, 46), 8-Jose Nabollin (16-Jess Valiente, 68), 11-Gabriel Urdaneta, 9-Giovanni Savarese, 10-Andrew Perez.

Paraguay: 1-Ruben Diaz, 2-Francisco Arce, 5-Pedro Sarabia, 3-Carlos Gamarra, 19-Jorge Alcaraz, 16-Julio Enciso, 15-Miguel Angel Benitez (11-Justo Meza, 73), 6-Estanislao Struway, 10-Roberto Acuna, 18-Aristides Rojas, (9-Richard Baez, 73), 8-Oswaldo Cohener (14-Virgilio Ferreira, 78).
